item.title: Online Event Shows 3 AIs and 9 Tools in 90 Minutes
item.description:
Online Event Shows 3 AIs and 9 Tools in 90 Minutes

An online, 90‑minute working session titled “3 AIs, 9 Tools, 90 Minutes: The Complete AI Stack for 2026” will walk professionals through a curated set of AI models and tools.

📅 Overview

  • Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes (90 minutes)\
  • Format: Online event\
  • Target audience: Professionals in the US and Canada, from newbies to seasoned users\
  • Goal: Demonstrate a ready‑to‑use AI stack for Monday‑morning workflows

🤖 AI Models Demonstrated

AI Model Session Note
Claude Run side by side in a real workflow
Gemini Run side by side in a real workflow
ChatGPT Run side by side in a real workflow

🛠️ Tools Covered

  • The session will showcase 9 powerful AI tools that complement the three models.
  • Tools are presented “tool by tool,” allowing participants to see exactly what to open on Monday morning.

🎯 Audience & Goal

  • Designed for professionals who are done reading roundup articles and want a hands‑on view.
  • Provides a side‑by‑side comparison to show where each AI “earns its place” and where it does not.

📍 Logistics

  • Location: Online event (accessible remotely)
  • Highlights: 90‑minute deep dive into the ultimate AI stack for 2026.

#AIStack #AIEvents #2026AI
